server.name: OHLCX
server.description: OHLCX MCP server: trading platform tools for strategies, backtests, signals, trades, workspaces, watchlists, screeners, markets, sectors, news, conditions, knowledge base, and user management.
server.instructions: OHLCX is a trading platform: strategies, backtests, signals, trades, workspaces, accounts, and market data. Tools expose the user's strategies (settings, schedule, statistics, performance), saved backtests, signals, trades, Workspaces, watchlists, markets, tickers and their price bars, screeners, sectors, news, conditions, and the knowledge base. No tool places, changes or cancels a broker order directly; a strategy that is switched on with orders on does. Confirm with the user before switching a strategy or its orders on, changing its settings, or deleting anything. Read the ohlcx://strategy-settings resource before creating a strategy or changing its settings. Prompts provide user context, product terminology (TSP, OCO, TRIM, order types), and support content from the knowledge base. When the user is authenticated, prefer using tools to fetch fresh data before answering.

prompts.name: user-info
prompts.description: Current user summary (authenticated MCP session only)

resources.name: strategy-settings
resources.description: Every strategy setting by section, with its allowed values

tools.name: run-support-agent
tools.notes: Laravel AI support agent (KB tools only); triggers LLM.

tools.name: run-trading-agent
tools.notes: Laravel AI trading assistant; authenticated MCP only; triggers LLM.

tools.name: get-user
tools.notes: Current user; admins may pass user_id for another user.

tools.name: delete-user
tools.notes: Delete by ID; cannot delete self.

tools.name: search-knowledge-base
tools.notes: Filter by area, q; uses DB. Available to all.

tools.name: get-knowledge-base-article
tools.notes: Article by slug; uses DB. Available to all.

tools.name: get-strategy-statistics
tools.notes: One strategy's statistics; optional period, status, direction.

tools.name: get-strategies-statistics
tools.notes: Statistics across all the user's strategies; optional period, status, direction.

tools.name: get-strategy-performance
tools.notes: One strategy's performance; optional period, status, direction.

tools.name: get-strategies-performance
tools.notes: Performance across all the user's strategies; optional period, status, direction.

tools.name: get-strategy-timeline
tools.notes: Get a strategy's activity timeline: what it did, day by day, over the last days.

tools.name: list-strategy-signals
tools.notes: List the signals a strategy has raised, 100 per page.

tools.name: list-strategy-trades
tools.notes: List the trades a strategy has taken, 100 per page.

tools.name: get-strategy-flags
tools.notes: List the flags a strategy's conditions have raised, 100 per page.

tools.name: set-strategy-status
tools.notes: Switch a strategy on or off (owner only).

tools.name: set-strategy-flag
tools.notes: signals, trades or orders (or their notifications): on, off, toggle (owner only).

tools.name: set-strategy-schedule
tools.notes: Set the days and hours a strategy is allowed to run. Times are New York time.

tools.name: update-strategy-settings
tools.notes: One validated section at a time; see the ohlcx://strategy-settings resource (owner only).

tools.name: clear-strategy-data
tools.notes: Delete a strategy's signals, trades or flags (owner only).

tools.name: list-backtests
tools.notes: Saved runs, newest first; optional strategy_id, page.

tools.name: get-backtest
tools.notes: One saved run; trades, equity and strategy_snapshot only when named in include.

tools.name: delete-backtest
tools.notes: Delete a saved backtest run. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: run-backtest
tools.notes: Server-side run; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: run-backtest-sweep
tools.notes: Server-side sweep over one or two settings; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: list-backtest-jobs
tools.notes: Server-side jobs with status and progress; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: get-backtest-job
tools.notes: Poll a server-side job; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: cancel-backtest-job
tools.notes: Cancel a waiting or running job; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: list-trades
tools.notes: Strategy trades; optional symbol, period, status, direction, page.

tools.name: get-trade
tools.notes: Get one strategy trade by ID.

tools.name: delete-trade
tools.notes: Delete a trade record; does not touch the broker.

tools.name: get-signal
tools.notes: Get one signal by ID, with its strategy and trades.

tools.name: delete-signal
tools.notes: Delete a signal. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: set-signal-action
tools.notes: like, unlike, ignore, unignore, watch or unwatch a signal.

tools.name: get-signal-actions
tools.notes: Get how the authenticated user has marked a signal: liked, ignored, watched.

tools.name: get-workspaces
tools.notes: The user's Workspaces document and its revision.

tools.name: save-workspaces
tools.notes: Replace the Workspaces document against a revision; a stale revision returns the current state.

tools.name: list-watchlists
tools.notes: The user's watchlists, the built-in ones, and the hidden built-ins.

tools.name: create-watchlist
tools.notes: Create an empty watchlist for the authenticated user. Add symbols with add-watchlist-symbols.

tools.name: rename-watchlist
tools.notes: Rename one of the authenticated user's watchlists.

tools.name: delete-watchlist
tools.notes: Delete one of the authenticated user's watchlists and the symbols in it. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: add-watchlist-symbols
tools.notes: Add one or more symbols to one of the authenticated user's watchlists. Symbols already in it are kept once.

tools.name: remove-watchlist-symbol
tools.notes: Remove one symbol from one of the authenticated user's watchlists.

tools.name: list-sectors
tools.notes: Sectors from proxied API; optional per_page.

tools.name: screen-market-gaps
tools.notes: Gap screen of a market; optional market_id, gap_min_percent, direction.

tools.name: screen-asset-gaps
tools.notes: Gap screen of one symbol; optional timeframe, gap_min_percent, direction.

tools.name: screen-technicals
tools.notes: Technical readings per symbol for a market; optional market_id, timeframe, search, page, per_page.

tools.name: get-ticker-bars
tools.notes: Price bars for a symbol; newest 200 by default, cursor paginated.

tools.name: get-ticker-analysis
tools.notes: Published analysis for one symbol; optional page.
